Design: plan/partner-matching-design.md · SQL: db/migrations/004_partner_matching.sql

- Button taps `pm_yes_<id>` / `pm_no_<id>` are caught by **Partner button?** before Switch
- Free text (Switch out 15) → LLM → **Validate partner request** → **Partner route**

- Every 15 min: proposals with no answer expire, the side that said yes is re-matched

parameters.content:
## Travel partner matching
Workflows 07–12 · SQL: db/migrations/005_travel_*.sql

- The LLM above also classifies `travel_*` intents → **Partner route** output 6 → **Travel assistant** (07)
- Buttons `tm_yes_<id>` / `tm_no_<id>` / `tm_block_<id>` and the trip form reply (flow token `travel_trip`) are caught by **Travel button?** before everything else
- 07 replies on its own; matching runs asynchronously (09) and never returns places or distances

## Google (ToriGoogle)
../ToriGoogle · workflow 22 `POST /webhook/tori/wa`

- **Google?** forwards `gg_` button / list taps, free text (not hi/menu, "20", "book …") and files when `TORI_GOOGLE_URL` is set
- `handled: true` → its WhatsApp messages are sent as they are
- otherwise (not linked, not a Google request, or unreachable) → **Back to bot** → the usual flow

## Held messages
SQL: db/migrations/008_held_messages*.sql

- WhatsApp only allows replies within 24 h of the user's last message (else a template)
- Offers / updates for people outside it are kept (**Hold offer**, **Hold update**)
- **Take held messages** sends them on the person's next message; "any match?" re-sends open offers
- Set PARTNER_MATCH_TEMPLATE to an approved template name to send offers right away instead

parameters.query: SELECT public.tori_take_held($1, $2::boolean) AS msgs;
